failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query 2: 'When was the 2PM music video "Take Off" released? Is "Take Off" a 2PM release?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question format bundling two distinct queries (release date + confirmation question), which the retriever cannot process optimally.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query 2: 'When was the 2PM music video "Take Off" released? Is "Take Off" a 2PM release?' and Query 3: 'When was the 2PM music video "Take Off" released, and what is the official release date of this song?' - Both queries ask for the same information (Take Off release date) with near-identical wording, despite Query 2 already successfully retrieving the answer (May 18, 2011). The queries fail to advance after the evidence gap was filled.
